description: This file defines the PackageController class for managing package operations in SuiteCRM, including package retrieval, download, installation, updates, and documentation handling.

classes.name: PackageController
classes.description: Controller class handling package management operations such as search, retrieval, download, installation, updates, and documentation in SuiteCRM.

methods.name: performBasicSearch
methods.description: Performs a basic search for packages based on search term and node ID.

methods.name: getPackages
methods.description: Retrieves packages belonging to a specified category.

methods.name: getReleases
methods.description: Fetches releases for a specific package and category, used for upgrades and installation.

methods.name: getPromotion
methods.description: Obtains a promotion from the package depot.

methods.name: download
methods.description: Downloads a specified package release and performs setup.

methods.name: getCategories
methods.description: Retrieves subcategories of a given category.

methods.name: getNodes
methods.description: Gets module loader category packages for a category.

methods.name: checkForUpdates
methods.description: Checks for updates for installed objects and patches.

methods.name: getLicenseText
methods.description: Displays license text for a specified file.

methods.name: getPackagesInStaging
methods.description: Lists packages currently staged for installation.

methods.name: performInstall
methods.description: Performs installation of a staged package.

methods.name: authenticate
methods.description: Authenticates user credentials for package depot access.

methods.name: getDocumentation
methods.description: Retrieves documentation for a package or release.

methods.name: rmMetaFile
methods.description: Removes metadata files like manifest or icon files related to a package.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes a package file and its metadata.
